description.zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号。
description.en: The ID of the account for which you want to query coverage summary. If you do not set this parameter, the data of the current Alibaba Cloud account and its RAM users is queried. To query the data of a RAM user, specify the ID of the RAM user.

description.zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；查询逻辑为不包括该时间；为空表示截止到当前时间
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end is excluded from the time range. If you do not set this parameter, the end time is the current time. Specify the time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

description.zh: MONTH：月维度； DAY：天维度； HOUR：小时维度；
description.en: The time granularity at which coverage summary are queried. Valid values: MONTH, DAY, and HOUR.

description.zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss； 查询逻辑为包括该时间
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The beginning is included in the time range. Specify the time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
